what: Expert slots of the skill gate (parkour/gate.py; HANDOFF.md section 3, rules of 29 Oct 20:15 and 20:20). The experts and checkpoints of the headroom measurement (scripts/gate_headroom.py -> results/skills/gate_headroom.json, 29 Oct 20:03-20:09), with the sha1 it recorded; paths relative to the repository root. skill = the slot's swap criterion (validation, simulator): basic, ice, extra = that group of the four-group validation sets; neo = the single-neo set (family 40, strict metric, policy alone); all = the mean over the four groups. A new expert replaces a slot's only if it beats it on that criterion (ties keep the old one); the gate is then fine-tuned with --init-from and --swap.
